scenario: You are on the Swiggy order-tracking team. QA has filed a bug against the live order screen.
symptom: The elapsed-time counter on the order screen shows 1s and never moves after that.

rubric.description: Every tick increments from the current elapsed value. No tick reuses a value that was captured earlier and never refreshed. Any mechanism that achieves this satisfies the criterion.
The displayed elapsed time keeps increasing every second, past 1.

The elapsed value is not faked. It is not a literal, not a precomputed sequence, and not a value computed once with nothing causing any further update. This criterion is about faking the value only; whether the value is correct is covered elsewhere.
If the component sets up an interval, timeout or subscription, it is cleared when the component unmounts. A component that sets up none satisfies this criterion.
